primary_dual_minus_frozen.pairing_unit: independent unseen task geometry with one independent observation stream; sixteen paired geometry tasks

scope: Paired total decision benefit of updating the query posterior after initialization; not a pure cross-policy propagation effect. Both terminal channels use their own real observations. Bootstrap intervals are copied from the completed summary, without new resampling.
interpretation: Thirteen second queries changed, but only twelve tasks improved actual and conditional safe reward; task10 changed query100 to98 without reward improvement. All twelve improvements query83, use its own raw observation to lower its point-only terminal utility, and switch from83 to unobserved98 whose terminal mean, point covariance and identity weights remain exactly at initialization. Task9 also succeeds while retaining83. The three failures (tasks10/14/15) retain unqueried83 with its initialized marginal unchanged and are truly infeasible. This supports the total decision benefit of adapting query selection; terminal gains here include queried-point correction, not online improvement of the unobserved98 terminal prediction or a pure cross-policy propagation effect.
